day: Day 1: Arrival in Pondicherry – French Quarter & Promenade
activities: Morning: Fly from Delhi to Chennai, then take a scenic drive (3–4 hours) to Pondicherry.
Afternoon: Check into your hotel in White Town and relax.
Evening: Walk along the Promenade Beach, see the Gandhi Statue, and explore colonial lanes in the French Quarter.
Night: Enjoy dinner at a French café like Café des Arts or Le Dupleix.

day: Day 2: Aurobindo Ashram, Churches & Heritage Walk
activities: Morning: Visit Sri Aurobindo Ashram and Manakula Vinayagar Temple.
Late Morning: Explore the Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus and Notre Dame des Anges.
Afternoon: Take a heritage walk through White Town’s colorful streets.
Evening: Explore Goubert Market and shop for local handicrafts.
Morning: Drive to Auroville (30 mins) – visit the Matrimandir viewing point and browse eco-friendly boutiques.
Afternoon: Have lunch at a café in Auroville and return to town.
Evening: Relax at Serenity Beach, go for a swim or sip coffee at the beachside shack.
Morning: Take a boat to Paradise Beach and enjoy some time in the sun.
Late Morning: Return, check out from your hotel, and shop for souvenirs.
Afternoon: Drive back to Chennai Airport for your flight to Delhi.
